entities.name: Bjørn Eidsvåg
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Bjørn Eidsvåg is a Norwegian pop singer, songwriter, and ordained Lutheran minister. He was born in Sauda Municipality, and is a graduate of the MF Norwegian School of Theology. He has released more than 25 albums since his 1976 debut and received the Norwegian music award the Spellemannsprisen at least three times.
